D1.evidence: B方案使用4个案例：①Reimagining Sustainable Urban Communities in Hong Kong(SMU亚洲管理洞察中心);②Resilient Residential Developments: Design Strategies for High-Density Cities(MAJ);③Sustainable urban renewal model for a high density city: Hong Kong(港理工博士论文2009);④Challenges, experience, and prospects of urban renewal in high-density cities: Hong Kong(Land期刊)。**4个案例均以香港为研究对象**，并非严格意义的'外部(非港)案例'。
